notes: Live TV Navigation Polish: Refined Live TV guide navigation, channel grid interactions, and electronic program guide (EPG) transitions.
TV Interface Enhancements: Refined card elevations, focus borders, and large-screen layout alignments.
Stream Switching Stability: Resolved edge-case stream switching stalls and unhandled player exit timeouts.
Live TV Reliability: Fixed channel switching focus traps and resolved audio/video stream sync delays during live channel playback.
Focus Traversal & NavInputLock: Resolved ANR focus-traversal loops and added a global navigation input lock to prevent rapid D-pad input queuing.
Network Port Isolation: Isolated internal diagnostic server (LogHttpServer) to port 8088 to eliminate local socket collisions.
UI & Performance: TV interface contrast tweaks and smoothness optimizations across horizontal media carousels.
Server Operations HUD: Real-time diagnostics overlay displaying live server operational metrics and session telemetry directly on TV.
Real-Time WebSocket Sync: Immediate bi-directional sync with Jellyfin servers over persistent WebSockets for live status updates.
Admin Session Controls: Remote session oversight and playback controls for multi-user server setups.
Native MDK Engine: Integrated high-performance native MDK multimedia player engine alongside MPV and Media3 for improved hardware decode support.
Pairing Handshake: Stabilized direct TV-to-server and mobile QR pairing handshakes.
Overlay & Session Lifecycle: Hardened session lifecycles across sleep/resume states and refined the transparent playback overlay deck.
Persistent Engine Singleton: Refactored MPV lifecycle into a persistent singleton engine to eliminate teardown latency and memory churn when cycling playback items.
In-App Diagnostic Logs: Added built-in log sharing and export tools to capture and inspect TV runtime diagnostics.
UI Polish: Overall playback stability and TV user interface refinements.
Dedicated Genre Browsing: Added dedicated Genre and Genre Details browsing screens with optimized D-pad focus handling.
Dynamic Screensaver: Screensaver now displays the matching movie or TV show title and rotates fresh cached backdrops.
MPV Audio & Sub Sync: Fixed audio stall and subtitle seek freeze issues in the MPV player engine.
Automatic Server Verification: Added auto-verification on Login, Add Server, and Add Account screens after entering server addresses.
Player Top Bar: Added header showing current time, estimated finish time ('Ends at'), and Up Next preview card for TV episodes.
Media Info Stream Dialog: On-screen info modal detailing Direct Play vs Transcode status, transcode reasons, container format, and video/audio codecs.
Refined Playback Controls: Centered on-screen menu buttons with adjusted focus spacing and aligned progress timestamps.
Accurate Audio & Subtitle Labels: Audio and subtitle selectors now display clean language codes without text truncation.
Stream Error & Recovery: Added dedicated error screen with a one-click Retry button for failed streams.
Watch Status Integrity: Fixed an issue where videos that failed to play could accidentally be marked as watched on the server.
Channel Logo Rendering: Fixed Live TV channel logos not displaying on initial launch.
Leaner Binary Footprint: Reduced APK size by stripping unused architecture components.
Targeted Compatibility: Stricter TV compatibility rules to guarantee smooth performance across Android TV and Google TV devices.
Leanback Manifest Targeting: Configured manifest declarations to strictly target Android TV and Google TV devices.
Navigation Refinements: Minor interface adjustments across D-pad directional navigation and on-screen keyboard input components.
Live TV Startup Fix: Resolved issue where Live TV channels failed to start on the first click.
Screensaver Input Isolation: Prevented screensaver clicks from passing through to underlying buttons and suppressed screensaver during active buffering.
Side Menu Focus Retention: Fixed focus loss to the side navigation rail when exiting Live TV playback.
Stream Resilience: Improved network retry handling for IPTV streams and refined details screen audio/subtitle badges.
Initial Aurelia TV Release: Native Android TV and Google TV client built exclusively for Jellyfin media servers.
TV-First Large Screen UI: Purpose-built media feeds, horizontal carousels, and directional D-pad focus handling.
Multi-Engine Multimedia Pipeline: Integrated support for Media3, MPV, and LibVLC playback engines with hardware acceleration.
Remote-Friendly Playback Deck: Trickplay timeline previews, chapter navigation, and synchronized watch progress reporting.
Multi-Account Profiles: Instant account and profile switching with independent authentication sessions.
